intro: UGX 120,000 across four people is UGX 30,000 each. Both figures below are yours to change.
program:
root = Col([headline, controls, shareCard, note], 16, "stretch")
headline = Title("Split the money", "lg")
amount = 120000
people = 4
amountField = Input($amount, "Total amount (UGX)", "number")
peopleField = Slider($people, 1, 12, 1, "Number of people", "people")
controls = Card([amountField, peopleField], "soft", 16, 14)
each = $amount / $people
eachValue = Title(@Format(each, "currency", 0, "UGX"), "2xl")
eachLine = Text("Each person gets", "sm")
exactLine = Text(["Exact figure: ", @Format(each, "number", 2), " each · total ", @Format($amount, "currency", 0, "UGX")], "sm")
shareCard = Card([eachLine, eachValue, exactLine], "outline", 16, 8)
note = Caption("Figures recalculate as you move either control.")
